text:
The trial court should **admit** the deposition testimony as former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1). The engineer is unavailable, and the company had an opportunity to develop the testimony when its attorney deposed him, and a similar motive because the falsity of the safety reports was central to both suits. The company could argue its motive in the wrongful-termination case, defending its firing decision, differed from its motive in the products case, but a court would likely find the motives similar enough.

CONFIDENCE: 70
